title: Corrected CoinRun dynamics browser demo
question: After the corrected PPO-mixture and dynamics-scale experiments finish, can the held-out-selected checkpoint serve sustained action-conditioned CoinRun inference through the local browser?
reason: CR-DEMO-0001 passed a runtime smoke but failed user quality review under a small tokenizer, random-action data and a broken Procgen action contract. CR-DYN-0008/0009 correct those inputs and require a new interactive evaluation rather than reusing the rejected checkpoint.
hypothesis: The held-out-selected corrected checkpoint will load, survive at least two consecutive generated steps without dtype drift, and expose action-conditioned trajectories suitable for direct user review.
falsification: Reject runtime usability if checkpoint selection is incomplete, the server fails to become healthy, either of two consecutive real steps fails, the SSH tunnel fails, or the user again judges representation clarity or action response unusable.

constants.checkpoint_selection: Descending held-out mean-frame PSNR then mean SSIM across the completed CR-DYN-0009 scale grid

compute.estimated_budget: interactive inference after CR-DYN-0008/0009 release the GPU
compute.shutdown_policy: Set a 12-hour shutdown timer when the demo process starts; do not run inference concurrently with training.

model.weights: EMA shortcut dynamics with 16.6M EMA tokenizer

evaluation.remote_health: GET /health returns ok=true and the selected model name
evaluation.remote_step: POST /api/step with action 4 returns a generated PNG
evaluation.local_health: The SSH-forwarded GET /health returns the same model
evaluation.local_step: A second POST /api/step through localhost returns the next generated PNG
evaluation.qualitative: The user directly reviews representation clarity and action response.

success_criteria.rule: CR-DYN-0008 and CR-DYN-0009 are complete and the selected checkpoint is backed by held-out metrics.
The remote server passes health and one real generated step.
The local SSH tunnel passes health and a second consecutive real generated step.
User visual review accepts both representation clarity and action responsiveness.
